name: Turkey, Brussels Sprout & Goat Cheese Pita with Beet-Arugula Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add garlic, turkey, and spices. Cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Once the turkey is done, add Brussels sprouts and cranberries to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the sprouts are just tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve lemon for the next step.)
Juice lemon into the reserved bowl; add mayo, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, peel, and coarsely grate beets; add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
When the sprouts are done, crumble goat cheese into the skillet, add lemon zest, and stir to combine the turkey filling.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with turkey filling.
To serve, divide pita pockets and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
